trigger: service of last pleading directed to the issue
applies_to: serve written jury demand (and file under 5(d))
notes: Court may order otherwise under 39(b)/6(b); failure waives jury (38(d)). Demand may sit in a pleading.

period: 14 days, or shorter time ordered by court
trigger: service of a demand that covers only some issues
applies_to: serve demand for jury on other issues
notes: Court may set a shorter period; extension by the court not stated in this text.

period: before opposing party serves answer or summary-judgment motion
trigger: service of answer or MSJ by opposing party
applies_to: file notice of dismissal without court order
notes: After the cutoff, dismissal needs stipulation of all appearing parties or court order (41(a)(1)(A)(ii), 41(a)(2)). Subject to Rules 23(e), 23.1(c), 23.2, 66.

applies_to: claimant's notice of voluntary dismissal of counterclaim, crossclaim or third-party claim
notes: Applies to 41(a)(1)(A)(i) dismissals.

period: before evidence is introduced at hearing/trial
trigger: introduction of evidence at hearing or trial
applies_to: claimant's notice of voluntary dismissal of counterclaim, crossclaim or third-party claim
notes: Alternative to 41(c)(1) when no responsive pleading exists.

applies_to: party completes the blank subpoena signed by clerk
notes: Clerk issues the subpoena signed but blank to a requesting party.

period: before the subpoena is served on the recipient
trigger: service of the subpoena on the non-party
applies_to: serve notice and copy of subpoena on each party
notes: Applies only to subpoenas for production or inspection before trial.

period: earlier of compliance date or 14 days
applies_to: serve written objection on party/attorney named in subpoena
notes: Paraphrase: deadline is whichever comes first. Serving party may move to compel any time after objection (see next row).

period: at any time after an objection (no fixed deadline)
applies_to: move court where compliance required for order compelling
notes: Notice to the commanded person required.

trigger: service of subpoena; commonly before compliance date
applies_to: move to quash or modify subpoena
notes: Rule states no number of days; 'timely' is judged by court. Separately, a subpoena giving too short a compliance time is itself a ground to quash.

applies_to: time allowed in subpoena for compliance
notes: Ground for mandatory quash/modification; no fixed minimum.

applies_to: return, sequester or destroy specified information; no use or disclosure meanwhile
notes: Duty not to use or disclose lasts until claim is resolved.

applies_to: present information under seal for determination
notes: Permissive (may), but must be done promptly if done.

applies_to: preserve produced information
notes: Duration-type limit.

applies_to: poll jurors (court must on party request)
notes: Window closes when jury is discharged.

applies_to: demand submission of issue not submitted under special verdict
notes: Otherwise jury right on that issue waived; court may find it.

period: at any time before case goes to jury
applies_to: move for judgment as a matter of law
notes: Required predicate to renewed motion under 50(b).

applies_to: file renewed motion for judgment as a matter of law (may add alternative new-trial request)
notes: Rule 6(b)(2) is understood to bar extension of this deadline (that rule is outside this reader's range; verify).

applies_to: file renewed JMOL on a jury issue not decided by a verdict
notes: Alternative trigger to 50(b) judgment trigger. Rule 6(b)(2) understood to bar extension; verify.

applies_to: file Rule 59 new-trial motion
binds: party against whom JMOL was rendered
notes: Rule 6(b)(2) understood to bar extension; verify.

period: close of evidence, or earlier reasonable time set by court
trigger: close of the evidence / court-set time
applies_to: file and furnish written instruction requests
notes: Court may set an earlier time by order.

period: after close of evidence, only for unanticipated issues or with leave
trigger: close of evidence / earlier court deadline
applies_to: file late requests for instructions
notes: Late requests allowed for issues that could not reasonably have been foreseen by the earlier deadline, or with court permission on any issue.

period: before instructing jury and before final jury arguments
applies_to: inform parties of proposed instructions and action on requests

period: before instructions and arguments are delivered
applies_to: provide opportunity to object on the record outside jury's hearing

period: at any time before jury discharged
applies_to: court's instructions to jury
notes: Permissive.

period: at the court's opportunity under 51(b)(2), or promptly after learning of unannounced instruction/ruling
trigger: opportunity to object, or learning of instruction/action on request
applies_to: object to instruction or failure to instruct
notes: Paraphrase of two alternative timeliness tests; second is 'promptly'.

period: after close of evidence (or in a filed opinion/memo)
applies_to: state findings of fact and conclusions of law
notes: Only a loose timing reference; no deadline.

applies_to: move to amend findings or make additional findings
notes: May accompany a Rule 59 motion. Rule 6(b)(2) understood to bar extension; verify.

period: court may wait until close of evidence
applies_to: enter judgment on partial findings
notes: Discretionary deferral.

applies_to: give parties notice and opportunity to be heard
master's work
notes: Appointing order must also set time limits for filing the record and for review (see next row).

applies_to: master's filings; review of master's actions
notes: Court fixes the time limits case by case; order may be amended (53(b)(4)).

trigger: master's affidavit disclosing grounds for disqualification
applies_to: order may issue only after affidavit (and waiver if ground disclosed)

period: any time, after notice and hearing opportunity
applies_to: amend appointing order
file order and serve copy
notes: Clerk must enter the order on the docket (no time stated).

period: promptly; report timing per appointing order
applies_to: serve copy of report on each party
notes: Court may order otherwise.

trigger: service of copy of master's order, report or recommendations
applies_to: file objections or motion to adopt/modify
notes: Court may set a different time.

applies_to: fix master's compensation per appointing order
notes: Court may set new basis after notice and hearing.

period: any time before judgment on all claims
trigger: entry of judgment adjudicating all claims and parties
applies_to: revise order that adjudicates fewer than all claims/parties
notes: Applies absent Rule 54(b) certification of no just reason for delay.

applies_to: clerk taxes costs
notes: Rule 54(d)(1) opens with 'unless ... a court order provides otherwise' (applies to costs award generally).

trigger: the clerk's taxation of costs (period after the 14-day notice)
applies_to: serve motion for court to review clerk's action
notes: Trigger text says 'within the next 7 days' after the clerk's action; paraphrased.

applies_to: file motion for attorney's fees and related nontaxable expenses
notes: Unless a statute or court order provides otherwise. Does not apply to sanctions fee claims (54(d)(2)(E)).

applies_to: serve written notice of application
notes: Only if defaulting party has appeared personally or by representative. Court may set hearing; 6(c) timing not applied here.

period: no later than 30 days after close of all discovery
applies_to: file motion for summary judgment
notes: Local rule or court order may set a different time.

applies_to: obtain affidavits or take discovery
notes: Court may defer or deny the motion instead.

applies_to: respond to court's proposed summary judgment
notes: No fixed length.

applies_to: respond before expense award
notes: No fixed length.

applies_to: hearing
notes: Discretionary.

trigger: general verdict, award of costs/sum certain, or denial of all relief
applies_to: prepare, sign and enter judgment
notes: Unless court orders otherwise; subject to Rule 54(b).

trigger: special verdict, general verdict with answers, or other relief
applies_to: court approves form; clerk enters
notes: Subject to Rule 54(b).

trigger: entry in civil docket under Rule 79(a)
applies_to: judgment deemed entered at earlier of separate document or 150 days
notes: This date starts the 28-day clocks for post-judgment motions if no separate document is made.

period: before notice of appeal is filed and effective
applies_to: court's order giving fee motion effect of timely Rule 59 motion
notes: Requires timely 54(d)(2) fee motion (14 days).

applies_to: file motion for new trial
notes: Rule 6(b)(2) understood to bar extension; verify.

trigger: service of new-trial motion with supporting affidavits
applies_to: file opposing affidavits
notes: Court may permit reply affidavits (no time stated). Affidavits supporting the motion must be filed with it.

applies_to: order new trial on court's own initiative
notes: Rule 6(b)(2) understood to bar extension; verify. Court may also grant a timely motion on grounds not in the motion after notice.

applies_to: file motion to alter or amend judgment
notes: Rule 6(b)(2) understood to bar extension; verify.

period: whenever found (no deadline) until appeal docketed
trigger: discovery of mistake / docketing of appeal
applies_to: correct clerical mistake or oversight
notes: After appeal is docketed and while pending, correction needs appellate leave.

trigger: entry of judgment or order or date of proceeding
applies_to: move for relief from judgment
notes: Reasonable time applies to every ground; outer limit of one year for grounds (1)-(3) is separate row.

trigger: entry of judgment or order, or date of proceeding
applies_to: move under mistake/neglect, new evidence, or fraud grounds
notes: Rule 6(b)(2) understood to bar extension of 60(b) time; verify.

applies_to: execution and enforcement proceedings stayed
notes: Court may order otherwise; exceptions in 62(c) and (d).

applies_to: obtain stay by providing bond or security
notes: Stay starts when court approves bond.

applies_to: stay duration
notes: Duration is set by the instrument.

applies_to: suspend, modify, restore or grant injunction
stay enforcement
motion for relief barred by appeal

trigger: district court statement that it would grant or raises substantial issue
applies_to: notify circuit clerk under FRAP 12.1
